body: ### Features - **Debugger:** Coordinate snapshot sampling per trace [#10677](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10677) - **Feature Flags:** Add debug-mode logging to the Feature Flags provider - **LLM Observability:** Accept an agent manifest manually [#10480](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10480) - **Test Optimization:** Record and upload WebdriverIO failure videos [#10566](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10566) - **Test Optimization:** Report Cypress suite TIA skip counts [#10670](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10670) ### Fixes - **Debugger:** Explain missing worker entry point [#10745](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10745) - **Debugger:** Leave payload size headroom below the backend event cap [#10346](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10346) - **Feature Flags:** Share EVP routing across event writers [#10633](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10633) - **General:** Use native URL when the global is mocked [#10729](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10729) - **LLM Observability:** Send events via the Lambda extension before the sandbox freezes [#9909](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9909) - **OpenTelemetry:** Use stable deployment environment resource key [#10664](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10664) - **Profiling:** Remove storage instrumentation when the profiler stops [#10627](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10627) - **Test Optimization:** Add location to injected afterEach hook for Playwright 1.64 [#10722](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10722) - **Test Optimization:** Ignore quarantined Jest snapshot failures [#10728](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10728) - **Test Optimization:** Support Vitest and WebDriverIO [#10731](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10731) - **tracer:** Avoid identity subscriptions in no-op imports [#10727](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10727) ### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking) - **claude-agent-sdk:** Fix tests by providing missing generated cassettes [#10706](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10706) - **Debugger:** Add a WorkerError class for worker failures [#10639](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10639) - **General:** Update one-pipeline version [#10646](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10646) - **light-my-request:** Select compatible Fastify test fixtures [#10725](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10725) - **Profiling:** Bump profiler to 5.20.0 [#10691](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10691) - **Serverless:** Enable asynchronous PR performance benchmarks [#10708](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10708) - **sirun:** Remove startup-share guard [#10589](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10589) - **sirun:** Retune variants under one minute [#10707](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10707) ### Contributors [](https://github.com/anmarchenko) [](https://github.com/erikayasuda) [](https://github.com/eunskin) [](https://github.com/IlyasShabi) [](https://github.com/joeyzhao2018) [](https://github.com/juan-fernandez) [](https://github.com/leoromanovsky) [](https://github.com/mabdinur) [](https://github.com/mz1119) [](https://github.com/NatachaMaly) [](https://github.com/purple4reina) [](https://github.com/rochdev) [](https://github.com/sabrenner) [](https://github.com/szegedi) [](https://github.com/TovRudyy) [](https://github.com/watson)
